caption: The drawing is done in pencil on a light beige background and depicts a round bowl with a decorative handle at the top. The bowl is shaded to suggest a metallic or reflective surface, and it is centrally placed within a rectangular border. The handle is integrated into the rim of the bowl and is composed of a symmetrical, ornate design featuring cut-out patterns, including two clover-shaped cutouts on either side and a central diamond-shaped cutout, with curved and circular motifs filling the rest of the space. At the lower right corner of the rectangular border, there is a small technical inset drawing, showing the dimensions and profile of the bowl and handle. Below the main drawing, slightly to the left, there is a cursive signature reading "Charles Cullen." The overall composition is monochromatic, utilizing various shades of gray to create depth and detail.
title: Pewter Porringer
